name: Agent Handoff Kit
author: Resonant Alpha
description: A governed handoff package that gives Codex and other coding agents the ResonantOS context, Hot Rod Rig constraints, source map, and verification gates needed to continue work without process inflation.

surfaces.label: Agent Handoff Kit
surfaces.description: Review the bounded agent handoff package, source evidence, implementation map, and deterministic verification gates.

workflowBoundaries.label: Evidence-bound agent handoff
workflowBoundaries.jobToBeDone: Package the current ResonantOS task context so another coding agent can continue with explicit files, constraints, and verification gates.
workflowBoundaries.userValue: The human can transfer work without losing channel-derived Hot Rod Rig context or allowing unsupported execution claims.
nonGoals: Execute shell commands or provider calls by itself
Claim autonomous Hot Rod Rig completion without ledger evidence
Write trusted Living Archive knowledge pages directly
Bypass repository AGENTS.md instructions or human approval gates

skills.name: Agent handoff orchestration
skills.description: Create a bounded coding-agent handoff from current repository evidence, Hot Rod Rig constraints, and deterministic verification requirements.

engineerSetup.objective: Continue implementing, testing, and auditing the Agent Handoff Kit as a ResonantOS browser-first add-on package.
expectedInputs: Bundled add-on manifest and browser-first host code
Hot Rod Rig and Z-Rig source documents listed in the package manifest
